name: Amazon Image ID Scan
description: Validates uploaded ID/document images with AWS Rekognition (DetectLabels + DetectText) during image-field widget validation.
project_description: Amazon Image ID Scan integrates the AWS Rekognition API to validate images uploaded through a Drupal image field. It ships a replacement image-field widget (ImageScanWidget, plugin id image_widget) that, when a file is uploaded, sends the raw image bytes to Rekognition's DetectLabels and DetectText operations and checks the result against an admin-defined validation profile: required ("positive") labels with a minimum confidence percentage, forbidden ("negative") labels, and regular expressions the OCR-detected text must match. If a check fails, the widget sets a form-validation error with the configured message, so the upload is rejected. Validation profiles and the AWS Rekognition credentials (access key and secret) are managed on the settings form at /admin/config/amazon_image_id_scan/configuration. Typical use is identity/document verification on registration, onboarding, KYC, hiring and government-procedure forms where a user must upload an ID card, passport or certificate and the site needs automated confirmation that the image is the expected kind of document and contains the expected text pattern.
